Title: A randomized, placebo-controlled trial of canakinumab in patients with peripheral artery disease
Author: Russell et al.
Comment: The placebo event count of 0 is inferred under the synthesis contract because the Results identify the single death as occurring in the canakinumab group and describe all five placebo adverse-event discontinuations as two peripheral stenting procedures and three cases of worsening claudication. The paper does not report an RR, so none was extracted. Randomized denominators were used (18 and 20).; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Canakinumab 150 mg subcutaneously monthly') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Multicenter prospective randomized double-blind placebo-controlled clinical trial
Medium: Subcutaneous canakinumab or placebo administered monthly
Topic of Content: IL-1β inhibition in symptomatic peripheral artery disease
Participant type: Adults with symptomatic peripheral artery disease and intermittent claudication
Outcome measurement: Narratively reported death after myocardial infarction among adverse-event discontinuations
effect_direction: RR < 1 favors interleukin-1 receptor antagonist therapy; observed mortality was higher with canakinumab than placebo

Title: Interleukin-1 Blockade in Recently Decompensated Systolic Heart Failure: Results From REDHART (Recently Decompensated Heart Failure Anakinra Response Trial)
Author: Van Tassell et al.
Comment: The two eligible anakinra regimens were combined as required: one death in the 2-week arm plus zero deaths in the 12-week arm, with randomized denominators pooled to n=40. The placebo denominator is the randomized n=20. Supplemental Table 6 instead labels the groups n=18, n=16, and n=18 among participants with at least one follow-up; these analyzed/follow-up counts were not used because the synthesis contract prespecifies randomized intention-to-treat denominators. No mortality-specific RR or P value was reported, so these fields are null; the reported log-rank P=0.10 pertains to the composite of death or HF readmission and was not extracted.
Design Type: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled three-arm parallel clinical trial
domain: Cardiovascular disease / systolic heart failure / interleukin-1 blockade
Study Environment: Recently hospitalized patients enrolled during the index admission or within 2 weeks after discharge
Content length: 12 weeks of assigned investigational treatment; clinical follow-up through 24 weeks
Topic of Content: Anakinra treatment after recently decompensated systolic heart failure
Participant type: Adults with recently decompensated systolic heart failure, LVEF <50%, and CRP >2 mg/L
Recruitment source: Consecutive patients screened during the initial hospital admission or within 2 weeks of discharge
Outcome measurement: Committee-adjudicated death from any cause through 24 weeks
effect_direction: RR < 1 favors interleukin-1 receptor antagonist therapy; observed mortality was lower with pooled anakinra regimens than placebo
